mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(c.id) AS id, c.title, c.description, c.thumbnail_url AS thumbnailUrl, c.deleted_at AS deletedAt, c.release_date AS releaseDate, c.origin_country AS originCountry, v.runtime_minutes AS runtimeMinutes, v.collection_name AS collectionName, v.imdb_id AS imdbId, v.release_status AS releaseStatus, v.number_of_seasons AS numberOfSeasons, v.number_of_episodes AS numberOfEpisodes, v.original_language AS originalLanguage, v.popularity, v.external_rating AS externalRating, v.external_rating_count AS externalRatingCount FROM contents c LEFT JOIN content_videos v ON v.content_id = c.id WHERE c.source = 'TMDB' AND c.type = #{type} AND c.source_id = #{sourceId} LIMIT 1
SELECT c.source_id FROM contents c WHERE c.source = 'TMDB' AND c.type = 'MOVIE' AND c.source_id IS NOT NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.release_date BETWEEN #{cutoffDate} AND #{today}

SELECT c.source_id FROM contents c JOIN content_videos v ON v.content_id = c.id WHERE c.source = 'TMDB' AND c.type = 'TV' AND c.source_id IS NOT NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND v.release_status = 'ONGOING'

SELECT role_type AS roleType, person_name AS personName, character_name AS characterName, display_order AS displayOrder, person_id AS personId, person_img AS personImg FROM content_people WHERE content_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId}) ORDER BY display_order, person_id
SELECT t.name, ct.source FROM content_tags ct JOIN tags t ON t.id = ct.tag_id WHERE ct.content_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId}) ORDER BY t.name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contents ( id, type, title, description, thumbnail_url, source, source_id, release_date, origin_country, average_rating, review_count, rating_sum, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}), #{type}, #{title}, #{description}, #{thumbnailUrl}, 'TMDB', #{sourceId}, #{releaseDate}, #{originCountry}, 0.0, 0, 0.00, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type = incoming.type, title = incoming.title, description = incoming.description, thumbnail_url = incoming.thumbnail_url, release_date = incoming.release_date, origin_country = incoming.origin_country

INSERT INTO content_videos ( content_id, runtime_minutes, collection_name, imdb_id, release_status, number_of_seasons, number_of_episodes, original_language, popularity, external_rating, external_rating_count ) VALUES ( UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId}), #{video.runtimeMinutes}, #{video.collectionName}, #{video.imdbId}, #{video.releaseStatus}, #{video.numberOfSeasons}, #{video.numberOfEpisodes}, #{video.originalLanguage}, #{video.popularity}, #{video.externalRating}, #{video.externalRatingCount} ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE runtime_minutes = incoming.runtime_minutes, collection_name = incoming.collection_name, imdb_id = incoming.imdb_id, release_status = incoming.release_status, number_of_seasons = incoming.number_of_seasons, number_of_episodes = incoming.number_of_episodes, original_language = incoming.original_language, popularity = incoming.popularity, external_rating = incoming.external_rating, external_rating_count = incoming.external_rating_count
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM content_people WHERE content_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId})
mapper.insert:
INSERT IGNORE INTO tags (id, name, kind, created_at) VALUES
(UUID_TO_BIN(#{tag.id}), #{tag.name}, #{tag.kind}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT IGNORE INTO content_tags (tag_id, content_id, source) SELECT id, UUID_TO_BIN(#{contentId}), 'OPENAPI' FROM tags WHERE name IN
#{tag.name}
